name: procore-open-items-review
description: Reviews the Procore items awaiting your workflow response: change risks, subcontractor invoices, commitment change orders, and purchase order and work order contracts. Filters out items you are only on distribution for. Re-derives pay-application AIA math and foots a commitment's schedule of values to its contract total. Reads attached support in the browser, and downloads only Word files. Publishes findings to a read-only dashboard. Skill version 45 — 2026-10-09.
